title: Reinfection with SARS-CoV-2 and Failure of Humoral Immunity
description:
Recovery from COVID-19 is associated with production of anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibodies,

but it is uncertain whether these confer immunity.

samples.title: Human sample from Homo sapiens
attributes: Highly multiplexed PCR amplicon NGS was performed on the D16nasopharyngeal swab, using the ARTIC V3 amplicon primer scheme, 7 and modifiedfrom the ARTIC protocol, 8 to approach the low copy number sample, as follows. RNAwas extracted from nasopharyngeal swab samples using the miRNeasy kit (Qiagen,Germantown, MD) and cDNA was synthesized with the LunaScript RT SuperMix kit(NEB, Ipswich, MA).
